description: Updated propeller efficiency and stall-speed data for the 8 priority aircraft. Includes full P-51D Pilot’s Notes table. Stall mostly IAS; CAS/EAS rare.

propeller_efficiency.notes: Use default for German types and Spitfire. Prefer NACA series for P-47.

p51d.notes: Gear and flaps up. Warning 3-4 mph above stall by elevator buffet. Mild stall.

p47d.source: Pilot’s notes + NACA L8A06 and flying-qualities report on P-47D-30
p47d.notes: Ample buffet warning ~4-5 mph above stall

fw190a8.notes: Sudden stall with little warning in clean config

spitfire5.source: NACA 'Stalling Characteristics of the Supermarine Spitfire VA Airplane' (Vensel & Phillips, 1942)
spitfire5.notes: Good buffet warning several mph above minimum speed; higher than Mk I

bf109e.notes: Flaps and undercarriage up; ~105 mph also reported in other trials

gaps: No clean CAS/EAS stall numbers at matched mass for most of the eight
German primary stall tables still missing
Spitfire V absolute IAS table still sparse
